questions.question:
Two position of a cube are shown below. What will come opposite to face containing ‘9’?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83a462e917d6448c764d0a5e38708edf69b45490089e92dc0b73940f83a8d0e8.png]
questions.solution:
There are two positions of the same dice is given.

In both the positions 8 is same.

So, when one element is the same in both the dices then rotate it either clockwise or anti-clockwise to find the opposite faces.

Here, in 1st position rotate clockwise from 8 so we get:

⇒ 8 ⇔ 7 ⇔ 9

In position 2, rotate clockwise from 8, we get:

⇒ 8 ⇔ 6 ⇔ 4

So, 7 is opposite to 6 and 9 is opposite to 4.

Hence, 4 is opposite to 9.

questions.question: A cube of side 12 cm is painted green on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 2 cm each. Find the number of smaller cubes that have only one face painted.
questions.solution:
A cube of side 12 cm is painted green on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 2 cm each.

Cube is divided into 12/2 = 6 equal parts, hence n = 6.

Number of cubes with 1 sides painted = 6(n - 2)²

= 6 (6 - 2)²

= 6 × 4²

= 6 × 16

= 96

Hence, '**96**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: A cube of side 18 cm is painted yellow on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 3 cm each. Find the number of smaller cubes that have only two faces painted.
questions.solution:
A cube of side 18 cm is painted yellow on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 3 cm each.

Cube is divided into 18/3 = 6 equal parts, hence n = 6.

Number of cubes with 2 sides painted = 12 (n - 2)

= 12 (6 - 2)

= 12 × 4

= 48 

Hence, '**48**' is the correct answer.
